title: Keep the first Auto strategy rules in shadow
question: Do source-bound observations and cheap predecision facts justify activating either Linux strategy rule?
summary: Keep the existing Linux opt-ins and report both shadow hypotheses. The correlated cases favor fusion, while the cheap input threshold misses them. Quota-index crossover and Analyze cost need more calibration.
